name: Apart Mare
beschreibung: The Apart Mare is a holiday apartment located in Sölden in the Ötztal Valley. The accommodation is situated in the town center of Sölden, approximately 300 meters from the valley stations of the Giggijoch and Zentrum Shuttle cable cars. The apartments feature a kitchenette, a seating area, and a balcony or terrace. A ski cellar and drying room are available to all guests. Free Wi-Fi and parking are included in the stay. The location provides direct access to hiking and biking trails in summer, as well as the slopes of the surrounding ski resorts in winter.
